item.text:
The strongest representation result has validation macro AUC 0.828326. The current task-conditioning topic reaches 0.812334, with small logloss regressions on three tasks; its stop-gradient contrasts leave the mechanism unresolved.

I’ll select a merge to test whether task conditioning adds value to the stronger representation. The decision will retain both source bests as controls and require gains beyond capacity and compute effects. This uses only the supplied summaries; no deeper trial records were available.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
p = Path('/workspace/topic-decision.json')
assert not p.exists(), 'Existing decision requires review before replacement'
decision = {
  'action': 'merge',
  'reason': 'Both sources improve validation four-task macro ROC-AUC over their baseline entry: g0 +0.018403 and g3 +0.002410. Test task conditioning on the stronger representation (0.828326); do not add their gains. g0 improves all task AUCs/loglosses; g3 improves AUCs but worsens cart/fav/buy logloss and macro logloss (+0.000028). Both-stop exceeds neither-stop by only 0.000235 AUC, so gradient isolation remains unresolved; these single-seed results are provisional. The existing relation/count merge is below its entry by 0.000401, further cautioning against assumed compatibility. Retain both frozen source bests, use replacement/factorial and capacity controls, and measure added cost: source models have 32,948,357/32,144,072 parameters and 31.36/32.48-second inference. Prioritize attribution and reserve budget for repeat confirmation and frozen assessment.',
  'evidence_refs': [
    'baseline-din',
    'g0-r0005-linear_moment',
    'g3-r0004-click_score_stop',
    'g3-r0005-both_stop',
    'g3-r0005-neither_stop',
    'g3-r0005-query_stop',
    'g3-r0005-history_stop',
    'g2-r0006-relation_count'
  ],
  'topic': {
    'title': 'Compatibility of task conditioning and linear-moment representation',
    'question': 'Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, can the g3 task-conditioning approach improve four-task macro ROC-AUC over the stronger g0 linear-moment source at justified parameter and measured compute cost?',
    'hypothesis': 'The source approaches may preserve complementary predictive information, but redundancy or task interference may erase the smaller task-conditioning gain. Inherit the two committed source approaches, subject to implementation inspection in the next phase; test their combination against both frozen source bests, especially g0 at 0.8283262734957326. Cross representation replacement with task-conditioning removal, retain the available gradient-stop contrasts, and compare capacity and equal training exposure while measuring training/inference cost. Added utility predicts a repeat-confirmed macro-AUC improvement over both sources beyond capacity controls. Failure to exceed g0, equivalent gains from capacity alone, or disappearance under replacement controls opposes complementary utility; unchanged stop contrasts would leave gradient isolation unsupported. Report every task AUC/logloss trade-off. Reserve resources for attribution and repeat confirmation; freeze selection and comparison suite before one withheld assessment. No mechanism or novelty is established by the present summaries.'
  },
  'source_topic_ids': ['g0-t000', 'g3-t000'],
  'merge_control_refs': ['g0-r0005-linear_moment', 'g3-r0004-click_score_stop'],
  'task_tradeoffs': {
    'is_click': 'Versus baseline and each source entry (both baseline-din), g0 AUC +0.015887/logloss -0.002000; g3 +0.002216/-0.000285. g3 is weaker than g0; incremental combination benefit is unmeasured.',
    'cart': 'Versus baseline and source entry, g0 AUC +0.018072/logloss -0.002389; g3 +0.003448/+0.000064. g3 ranking improves with worse calibration loss; combination trade-off is unresolved.',
    'fav': 'Versus baseline and source entry, g0 AUC +0.015764/logloss -0.001656; g3 +0.003389/+0.000031. g3 ranking improves with worse logloss; no additive gain is established.',
    'buy': 'Versus baseline and source entry, g0 AUC +0.023889/logloss -0.001534; g3 +0.000588/+0.000301. This is g3\\'s smallest AUC gain and largest task logloss regression, with 4,036 validation positives; combination benefit remains uncertain.'
  }
}
p.write_text(json.dumps(decision, indent=2) + '\\n')
loaded = json.loads(p.read_text())
allowed = {'baseline-din','g0-r0003-relation_content_counts','g0-r0005-linear_moment','g1-r0001-lowrank_static','g2-r0004-count_shrink','g2-r0006-relation_count','g3-r0004-click_score_stop','g3-r0005-both_stop','g3-r0005-history_stop','g3-r0005-neither_stop','g3-r0005-query_stop'}
assert loaded['action'] == 'merge'
assert len(loaded['source_topic_ids']) == 2
assert loaded['merge_control_refs'] == ['g0-r0005-linear_moment','g3-r0004-click_score_stop']
assert set(loaded['evidence_refs']) <= allowed
assert set(loaded['merge_control_refs']) <= set(loaded['evidence_refs'])
assert set(loaded['task_tradeoffs']) == {'is_click','cart','fav','buy'}
print('Wrote and validated /workspace/topic-decision.json')
PY"
